datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2012 across Malawi administrative units. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases derived from food security assessments and integrated into geographic datasets for spatial analysis of food insecurity impacts.
